title: TOEIC Writing Q6-7: Company Business / Events
description: Email công sở: phỏng vấn nghỉ việc, sự cố máy tính, nhân viên mới.

prompts.title: Exit interview

email.subject: Exit interview
body: Since you'll soon be leaving our company for another job, I'd like to meet with you for a brief discussion.
To prepare for that meeting, could you send me an e-mail about your experience working here and how the company can improve?
translationVi: Vì cô sắp rời công ty để chuyển sang công việc khác, tôi muốn gặp cô để trao đổi ngắn.
Để chuẩn bị cho buổi gặp, cô có thể gửi email về trải nghiệm làm việc tại đây và cách công ty có thể cải thiện không?

prompts.directions: Respond to the e-mail. In your e-mail, give ONE piece of information and make TWO suggestions.
prompts.roleVi: Bạn là Ms. Peters, sắp rời công ty và cần phản hồi phòng nhân sự.

tasks.label: Information
tasks.requirement: Give one piece of information about your experience.

tasks.label: Suggestion 1
tasks.example: I think the company can improve by allowing employees to work from home more often.

tasks.label: Suggestion 2
tasks.requirement: Make a second suggestion for improvement.
tasks.example: Another suggestion is to give employees more vacation time.

vocabulary.example: The company should allow employees to work from home twice a week.

vocabulary.meaningVi: cho thêm thời gian nghỉ phép
vocabulary.example: Another suggestion is to give employees more vacation time.

vocabulary.meaningVi: có thời gian cho việc gì
vocabulary.example: I am available for the meeting on Friday.
I need time to prepare for the presentation.

patterns: I think the company can improve by ...
Thank you for asking for my opinion.
sampleAnswer: Hello, Ms. Richards,
Thank you for asking about my experience working here.
I enjoyed working here, but the commute was very long.
I think the company can improve by allowing employees to work from home more often.
Another suggestion is to give employees more vacation time.
Thank you.

sampleBlanks.sentence: I enjoyed working here, but the _____ was very long.
sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Tôi thích làm việc ở đây, nhưng quãng đường đi làm rất xa.

sampleBlanks.answer: allowing employees to work from home
sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Công ty có thể cải thiện bằng cách cho nhân viên làm việc tại nhà.
Một đề xuất khác là cho nhân viên thêm thời gian nghỉ phép.

guidedOutline.opening: Thank you for asking about my experience working here.

prompts.title: Computer problems

email.subject: Computer problems
body: I have been having problems with my office computer recently.
I requested assistance from the help desk several times but they have not fixed it yet.
Could you please help me find a way to solve this problem?
translationVi: Gần đây tôi gặp vấn đề với máy tính văn phòng.
Tôi đã yêu cầu bộ phận hỗ trợ nhiều lần nhưng họ vẫn chưa sửa.
Ông có thể giúp tôi tìm cách giải quyết vấn đề này không?

prompts.directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are Mr. Slate. In your e-mail, ask ONE question and make TWO suggestions about getting the computer fixed.
prompts.roleVi: Bạn là Mr. Slate, quản lý hỗ trợ Barry xử lý sự cố máy tính.

tasks.label: Question
tasks.requirement: Ask one question about the computer problem.
tasks.example: Exactly how long ago did you contact the help desk?

tasks.label: Suggestion 1
tasks.requirement: Make one suggestion about getting support.
tasks.example: I think you should visit the help desk in person.

tasks.label: Suggestion 2
tasks.requirement: Make a second suggestion if the issue continues.
tasks.example: If that does not work, please ask to speak to the help desk manager.

vocabulary.example: The company should allow employees to work from home twice a week.

vocabulary.meaningVi: bộ phận hỗ trợ kỹ thuật
vocabulary.example: The help desk can repair your computer.
You should speak with them in person.
We can get the problem fixed soon.

patterns: If that does not work, please ...
sampleAnswer: Hi Barry,
I understand your problem and I am sorry that the help desk has not solved it yet.
Exactly how long ago did you contact them?
I think you should visit the help desk in person and explain the issue again.
If that does not work, please ask to speak to the help desk manager.
Do not worry. I am sure we can get your computer fixed soon.
Slate

prompts.title: Welcome to the department

email.subject: Welcome
body: I'm happy to have you in our department.
Please tell me if there is anything I can do to make your transition here more comfortable.
And let me know if you have any questions about working in our office.
translationVi: Tôi rất vui khi có bạn trong phòng ban của chúng tôi.
Hãy cho tôi biết nếu có điều gì tôi có thể làm để giúp quá trình chuyển sang đây thoải mái hơn.
Và hãy cho tôi biết nếu bạn có câu hỏi nào về việc làm việc tại văn phòng của chúng tôi.

prompts.directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are A. Means. In your e-mail, ask TWO questions about working in the new office and make ONE request.
prompts.roleVi: Bạn là A. Means, nhân viên mới chuyển đến văn phòng.

tasks.label: Question 1
tasks.requirement: Ask one question about the new office.
tasks.example: Can you tell me where my desk will be located?

tasks.label: Question 2
tasks.requirement: Ask a second question about office work.
tasks.example: Will there be a meeting for new employees soon?

tasks.label: Request
tasks.requirement: Make one request to help your transition.
tasks.example: Could you provide me with a copy of the office schedule?

vocabulary.example: I want to make the transition smoother.
Could you provide me with the office schedule?
There will be a meeting for new employees.

sampleAnswer: Hello, Mr. Spata,
I am very happy to be moving to your department.
Could you provide me with a copy of the office schedule?
Also, can you tell me where my desk will be located?
Lastly, will there be a meeting for new employees soon?
I am looking forward to working with you.
Thank you,
A. Means
